section_summary.extract_value: This section presents the abstract of a study that investigated the psychometric properties of the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2) in Brazilian adolescents. The sample consisted of 438 boys and 402 girls, with mean ages of 15.50 and 15.51 respectively. The study found that body appreciation was negatively correlated with body mass index in both genders, but no specific correlation coefficient was provided.
